title: The Tiny Building Blocks
intro: This quiz checks what you learned about atoms, molecules, and compounds — the tiny building blocks of everything around us.

choices: Two or more elements mixed together
The smallest unit of an element that retains its properties
A substance made of different molecules
Two or more atoms bonded together
questions.explanation: An atom is the smallest unit of an element that retains its properties.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is an element?
questions.explanation: Gold (Au) is an element. Water, carbon dioxide, and salt are compounds.

choices: Two or more atoms chemically bonded together
A substance made of only different elements
questions.explanation: A molecule is two or more atoms chemically bonded together.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is a molecule but NOT a compound?
questions.explanation: Oxygen gas (O₂) is a molecule made of the same element, so it is not a compound.

questions.prompt: Why is water (H₂O) both a molecule and a compound?
choices: It contains hydrogen and oxygen atoms chemically bonded together
It is a mixture of hydrogen and oxygen
questions.explanation: Water is both a molecule and a compound because it contains hydrogen and oxygen atoms chemically bonded together.
